ex.en: A great number of books are published every year.
ex.zh: 每年都有大量的書出版。

ex.en: He has written a book, however, he has no money to publish it.
ex.zh: 他寫了一本書，可是沒錢出版。

ex.en: He publishes books in Italy.
ex.zh: 他在義大利出版圖書。

publish.en: to produce a book, magazine or paper for people to buy

ex.en: He has just published an interesting series of articles.
ex.zh: 他剛發表了一系列有趣的文章。

ex.en: The results will be published next month.
ex.zh: 結果將於下個月公布。

publish.en: to make information known to the public

ex.en: The purchaser must sign the contract.
ex.zh: 買方必須簽署合約。

ex.en: The purchaser has 30 days to return the item.
ex.zh: 購買者有 30 天可以退貨。

ex.en: She found her purse under the desk.
ex.zh: 她在書桌底下找到了她的錢包。

ex.en: It occurred to me that I had left my purse at home.
ex.zh: 我突然想到我把錢包忘在家裡了。

ex.en: I had my purse stolen in the bus.
ex.zh: 我的錢包在公車上被偷了。

purse.en: a small bag for money, or a handbag in American English

ex.en: She pursed her lips and said nothing.
ex.zh: 她抿著嘴，什麼也沒說。

ex.en: He pursed his lips in disapproval.
ex.zh: 他不以為然地噘起嘴。

purse.en: to press the lips together tightly, often to show dislike

ex.en: She doesn't like people who are not punctual.
ex.zh: 她不喜歡不守時的人。

ex.en: I make a point of being punctual.
ex.zh: 我很注重準時。

ex.en: You can rely upon his being punctual.
ex.zh: 你放心，他一定會準時。

punctual.en: arriving or doing things at the right time, not late

ex.en: Tom was a bit puzzled by Mary's answer.
ex.zh: 瑪麗的回答讓湯姆有點困惑。

ex.en: Tom was puzzled by what Mary said.
ex.zh: 瑪麗說的話讓湯姆很困惑。

ex.en: I was puzzled about what to do next.
ex.zh: 我不知道接下來該做什麼，感到很困惑。

puzzle.en: to make someone confused because they cannot understand

ex.en: No one could solve the puzzle.
ex.zh: 沒人解得了這個謎題。

ex.en: Can you solve this puzzle?
ex.zh: 你能解開這個謎題嗎？

ex.en: We spent the afternoon doing a jigsaw puzzle.
ex.zh: 我們花了一個下午拼拼圖。

puzzle.en: a game or problem that is hard to solve, or something hard to understand

ex.en: We need to publicize the event on social media.
ex.zh: 我們需要在社群媒體上宣傳這個活動。

ex.en: The company widely publicized its new product.
ex.zh: 公司大力宣傳它的新產品。

publicize.en: to make something known to many people

purser.zh: （飛機的）座艙長；（船上的）事務長

ex.en: The purser welcomed the passengers on board.
ex.zh: 座艙長歡迎乘客登機。

ex.en: Please ask the purser if you need any help.
ex.zh: 需要協助的話，請找座艙長。

purser.en: the officer who looks after passengers and money on a ship or plane

ex.en: Publicly express your love for someone.
ex.zh: 公開表達你對某人的愛。

ex.en: The CEO publicly apologized for the mistake.
ex.zh: 執行長公開為這個錯誤道歉。

ex.en: The company's shares are publicly traded.
ex.zh: 這家公司的股票公開上市交易。

publicly.en: in a way that everyone can see or know about

ex.en: You'll be punished if you break the law.
ex.zh: 如果你違法，就會受到懲罰。

ex.en: My mother never punishes me.
ex.zh: 我媽媽從來不處罰我。

ex.en: Tom wanted to punish me.
ex.zh: 湯姆想處罰我。

punish.en: to make someone suffer because they did something wrong

ex.en: What punishment awaits him?
ex.zh: 他會受到什麼樣的懲罰？

ex.en: Many countries have abolished capital punishment.
ex.zh: 許多國家已經廢除了死刑。

ex.en: Cleaning the classroom was his punishment for being late.
ex.zh: 打掃教室是他遲到的處罰。

punishment.en: something unpleasant done to a person who did something wrong

ex.en: I met him purely by chance.
ex.zh: 我遇到他純屬巧合。

ex.en: This decision was made purely for financial reasons.
ex.zh: 這個決定純粹是基於財務考量。

ex.en: The trip is purely for business.
ex.zh: 這趟行程純粹是出差。

ex.en: The company is in pursuit of new markets.
ex.zh: 公司正在開拓新市場。

ex.en: Everyone has the right to the pursuit of happiness.
ex.zh: 每個人都有追求幸福的權利。

pursuit.en: the act of trying to get or achieve something

ex.en: Reading is one of my favorite pursuits.
ex.zh: 閱讀是我最喜歡的休閒活動之一。

ex.en: Hiking is a popular outdoor pursuit in Taiwan.
ex.zh: 爬山是台灣很受歡迎的戶外活動。

pursuit.en: an activity you do for fun in your free time

ex.en: Pursuant to the contract, payment is due in 30 days.
ex.zh: 依據合約，款項須於三十天內支付。

ex.en: The meeting was held pursuant to company rules.
ex.zh: 這場會議依照公司規定召開。

pursuant.en: used to say that something is done according to a rule or agreement

ex.en: Tom puts gas in his car twice a week.
ex.zh: 湯姆每週幫車子加兩次油。

ex.en: Mary puts salt on just about everything she eats.
ex.zh: 瑪莉吃什麼都要加鹽。

ex.en: Put your bag on the chair.
ex.zh: 把你的包包放在椅子上。

put.en: to move something into a place or position, or to add something to it

ex.en: I have trouble putting up with his rude manner.
ex.zh: 我受不了他那種無禮的態度。

ex.en: You have to put up with all these noises.
ex.zh: 你得忍受這些噪音。

put.en: to accept something annoying or unpleasant without complaining

ex.en: The party has been put off until next Tuesday.
ex.zh: 派對已經延到下週二。

ex.en: Don't put off your work until tomorrow.
ex.zh: 別把工作拖到明天。

put.en: to decide or arrange to do something at a later time

ex.en: Put on your shoes. Let's go out for dinner.
ex.zh: 穿上鞋子，我們出去吃晚餐吧。

ex.en: Put on your jacket; it's cold.
ex.zh: 穿上外套，外面很冷。

put.en: to dress yourself in a piece of clothing or wear something on your body

ex.en: I saw a horse pulling a cart.
ex.zh: 我看到一匹馬拉著一台馬車。

ex.en: Just pull the door shut. It'll lock by itself.
ex.zh: 只要把門拉上就好，它會自動上鎖。

pull.en: to hold something and move it toward you or along behind you

ex.en: He pulled up the weed and threw it away.
ex.zh: 他把雜草拔起來丟掉。

ex.en: I need a tool for pulling weeds in my garden.
ex.zh: 我需要一個工具來拔花園裡的雜草。

pull.en: to take something out of a place by using force

ex.en: The car pulled up in front of the bank.
ex.zh: 那輛車在銀行前停了下來。

ex.en: A taxi pulled up outside the hotel.
ex.zh: 一輛計程車停在飯店外面。

pull.en: to slow down and stop, as a car does

ex.en: I saw Tom pushing a stroller down the sidewalk.
ex.zh: 我看到湯姆推著嬰兒車走在人行道上。

ex.en: We got behind the car and pushed.
ex.zh: 我們繞到車子後面推車。

ex.en: He fouled because he pushed over the other player.
ex.zh: 他犯規了，因為他把對方球員推倒了。

push.en: to press something so that it moves away from you

ex.en: Push the red button if something strange happens.
ex.zh: 如果發生奇怪的事，就按紅色按鈕。

ex.en: I don't know which button to push.
ex.zh: 我不知道要按哪個按鈕。

push.en: to press a button or switch with your finger

ex.en: Hasn't Huiru sent the slides yet? The client's pushing.
ex.zh: 慧如還沒把簡報傳過來嗎？客戶在催了。

ex.en: My parents pushed me to study harder.
ex.zh: 我爸媽逼我更用功讀書。

ex.en: The company is pushing for faster growth.
ex.zh: 公司正積極推動更快速的成長。

push.en: to urge someone to act faster, or to work hard to make something happen

ex.en: Some people pursue only pleasure.
ex.zh: 有些人只追求享樂。

ex.en: She left her job to pursue her dream.
ex.zh: 她辭掉工作去追求夢想。

pursue.en: to work toward a goal or try to get something over a long time

ex.en: He plans to pursue a career in law.
ex.zh: 他打算從事法律工作。

ex.en: We decided not to pursue the matter further.
ex.zh: 我們決定不再追究這件事。

pursue.en: to continue to do an activity or study something further

ex.en: The police are pursuing an escaped prisoner.
ex.zh: 警方正在追捕一名逃犯。

ex.en: The police will pursue her for a long time.
ex.zh: 警察會追捕她很長一段時間。

pursue.en: to follow someone or something in order to catch them

ex.en: Publication of the article was timed to coincide with the professor's birthday.
ex.zh: 這篇文章特意安排在教授生日那天發表。

ex.en: The book is ready for publication.
ex.zh: 這本書已經可以出版了。

publication.en: the act of making a book or other work available for the public

ex.en: The company has several monthly publications.
ex.zh: 這家公司有好幾份月刊。

ex.en: This publication is available online for free.
ex.zh: 這份刊物可以在網路上免費閱讀。

publication.en: a book, magazine or paper that is printed for sale

ex.en: How many pupils are there in your school?
ex.zh: 你們學校有多少學生？

ex.en: This class is made up of thirty-five pupils.
ex.zh: 這個班有三十五名學生。

pupil.en: a child who goes to school

ex.en: The doctor checked the size of my pupils.
ex.zh: 醫生檢查了我瞳孔的大小。

ex.en: Your pupils get bigger in the dark.
ex.zh: 在暗處瞳孔會放大。

pupil.en: the black round part in the middle of the eye

ex.en: There's a pub just around the corner.
ex.zh: 轉角就有一家酒吧。

ex.en: We're going down the pub. Do you fancy coming?
ex.zh: 我們要去酒吧，你想一起來嗎？

pub.en: a place where people go to drink and talk, especially in Britain

ex.en: These fabrics are made of pure wool.
ex.zh: 這些布料是純羊毛製的。

ex.en: Europeans drink, on average, 12.5 liters of pure alcohol per year.
ex.zh: 歐洲人平均每年喝下 12.5 公升的純酒精。

ex.en: The sample is not pure enough.
ex.zh: 樣本不夠純淨。

ex.en: The water from this spring is very pure.
ex.zh: 這口泉水非常純淨。

pure.en: clean and free from anything harmful

ex.en: It was pure luck that we met.
ex.zh: 我們會相遇純粹是運氣。

ex.en: It was pure chance that I found the file.
ex.zh: 我找到這份檔案純屬偶然。

ex.en: The water pump in the basement is broken.
ex.zh: 地下室的抽水馬達壞了。

ex.en: I need a pump for my bike tires.
ex.zh: 我需要一個打氣筒幫腳踏車輪胎打氣。

pump.en: a machine or tool that moves liquid or air into or out of something

ex.en: We pumped the water out of the basement.
ex.zh: 我們把地下室的水抽出來。

ex.en: He pumped air into the tires.
ex.zh: 他幫輪胎打氣。

pump.en: to move liquid or air somewhere using a machine or tool

ex.en: This publisher specializes in children's literature.
ex.zh: 這家出版社專門出版兒童文學。

ex.en: The publisher will release her new book in May.
ex.zh: 出版社將在五月推出她的新書。

ex.en: He sent his novel to several publishers.
ex.zh: 他把小說寄給了好幾家出版社。

publisher.en: a company that prints and sells books or magazines

ex.en: The doctor is taking the patient's pulse.
ex.zh: 醫生正在幫病人量脈搏。

ex.en: The doctor thought the patient's pulse was rather rapid.
ex.zh: 醫生認為病人的脈搏有點快。

ex.en: Is his pulse regular?
ex.zh: 他的脈搏規律嗎？

pulse.en: the regular beat of blood that you can feel at your wrist

pulse.zh: (have/keep) a finger on the pulse：掌握最新動態

ex.en: She has her finger on the pulse.
ex.zh: 她總能掌握最新的潮流動態。

ex.en: A good manager keeps a finger on the pulse of the market.
ex.zh: 好的經理會隨時掌握市場動態。

pulse.en: to know about the newest events and changes in a field

ex.en: Music pulsed through the room.
ex.zh: 音樂的節奏在房間裡迴盪。

ex.en: The lights pulsed to the beat.
ex.zh: 燈光隨著節拍閃動。

pulse.en: to beat or move in a steady, regular way

ex.en: I punched Tom.
ex.zh: 我揍了湯姆一拳。

ex.en: The boxer punched the bag again and again.
ex.zh: 拳擊手一拳又一拳地打著沙包。

punch.en: to hit someone or something hard with a closed hand

ex.en: He gave the punching bag a hard punch.
ex.zh: 他朝沙包狠狠打了一拳。

ex.en: She threw a punch at the training pad.
ex.zh: 她朝訓練用的護墊揮了一拳。

punch.en: a hard hit with a closed hand

ex.en: The conductor punched my ticket.
ex.zh: 列車長幫我剪了票。

ex.en: Punch two holes in the paper and put it in the binder.
ex.zh: 在紙上打兩個洞，然後放進資料夾。

punch.en: to make a hole in something with a tool

ex.en: Would you like a glass of punch?
ex.zh: 要來一杯水果酒嗎？

ex.en: She made a big bowl of fruit punch for the party.
ex.zh: 她為派對調了一大碗水果酒。

punch.en: a sweet drink made from fruit juice, sometimes with alcohol

ex.en: You must be more careful about spelling and punctuation.
ex.zh: 你得要更注意拼字和標點符號。

ex.en: An exclamation mark is a punctuation mark.
ex.zh: 感嘆號是標點符號。

ex.en: Try not to forget punctuation next time.
ex.zh: 下次儘量別忘了加標點。

punctuation.en: marks such as commas and full stops used in writing

ex.en: Water purification is essential to prevent disease.
ex.zh: 淨化水源對預防疾病非常重要。

ex.en: The hospital uses an air purification system in the operating rooms.
ex.zh: 醫院的手術室使用空氣淨化系統。

purification.en: the process of making something clean by removing harmful things

ex.en: Smoking is a major cause of pulmonary disease.
ex.zh: 吸菸是肺部疾病的主要原因之一。

ex.en: He was sent to a pulmonary specialist for his breathing problems.
ex.zh: 他因為呼吸問題被轉診給胸腔科醫師。

ex.en: Public morals are not respected anymore in this town.
ex.zh: 這個城鎮的人已經不再重視公共道德。

ex.en: Smoking is not allowed in public places.
ex.zh: 公共場所禁止吸菸。

public.en: relating to or shared by all the people in a community

ex.en: The exhibition has drawn much attention from the public.
ex.zh: 這場展覽引起了大眾的高度關注。

ex.en: The museum is open to the public every day.
ex.zh: 博物館每天對外開放。

ex.en: You will soon get used to speaking in public.
ex.zh: 你很快就會習慣當眾說話了。

ex.en: The politician didn't appear in public after the incident.
ex.zh: 那件事之後，那位政治人物就沒再公開露面。

public.en: where other people can see or hear

ex.en: You don't have to worry about publicity.
ex.zh: 你不用擔心宣傳的事。

ex.en: The scandal brought a lot of negative publicity.
ex.zh: 這場醜聞帶來很多負面報導。

publicity.en: attention from newspapers and television, or advertising to get attention

ex.en: You cannot purchase this medicine without a prescription.
ex.zh: 那種藥沒有處方就買不到。

ex.en: To purchase a ticket, you need to enter your personal details.
ex.zh: 購票前需要先輸入個人資料。

ex.en: If I had the money, I would immediately purchase this computer.
ex.zh: 我要是有錢，馬上就買這台電腦。

ex.en: They are saving their money for the purchase of a house.
ex.zh: 他們在存錢買房子。

ex.en: Keep the receipt as proof of purchase.
ex.zh: 請保留收據作為購買證明。

purchase.en: the act of buying, or something that you have bought

ex.en: Punctuality is important for client meetings.
ex.zh: 與客戶開會時，準時很重要。

ex.en: Her punctuality made a good impression on the team.
ex.zh: 她守時的態度讓團隊留下好印象。

punctuality.en: the habit of arriving or doing things at the right time

ex.en: He went to Italy for the purpose of studying music.
ex.zh: 他去義大利的目的是學習音樂。

ex.en: She came to Japan for the purpose of studying Japanese.
ex.zh: 她為了學習日文來到日本。

ex.en: Many people drift through life without a purpose.
ex.zh: 許多人毫無目的地隨波逐流。

purpose.en: the reason why you do something or why something exists

ex.en: You made the mistake on purpose, didn't you?
ex.zh: 你是故意犯這個錯的，對吧？

ex.en: He made mistakes on purpose to annoy me.
ex.zh: 他為了惹惱我故意犯錯。

purpose.en: in a way that is planned, not by accident

ex.en: We can't ship the goods until we receive a purchase order.
ex.zh: 收到採購單之前，我們無法出貨。

ex.en: Please write the purchase order number on the invoice.
ex.zh: 請在請款單上寫上採購單號碼。

purchase order.en: an official document sent to a seller to order goods

ex.en: Could you put me through to the sales department?
ex.zh: 可以幫我轉接業務部嗎？

ex.en: Please hold while I put you through.
ex.zh: 請稍候，我幫您轉接。

put through.en: to connect someone by telephone to the person they want to talk to

ex.en: She works in publishing and edits children's books.
ex.zh: 她在出版業工作，負責編輯童書。

ex.en: The publishing of the new novel was delayed until spring.
ex.zh: 這本新小說的出版延到了春天。

ex.en: Purple is my sister's favorite color.
ex.zh: 紫色是我姊姊最喜歡的顏色。

ex.en: The sky turned orange and purple at sunset.
ex.zh: 日落時，天空變成橘色和紫色。

ex.en: She wore a purple dress to the party.
ex.zh: 她穿了一件紫色洋裝去參加派對。

ex.en: The purple flowers in the garden smell wonderful.
ex.zh: 花園裡的紫色花朵聞起來很香。

ex.en: We had chocolate pudding for dessert.
ex.zh: 我們的甜點是巧克力布丁。

ex.en: Grandma makes a warm rice pudding in winter.
ex.zh: 奶奶冬天會做熱熱的米布丁。

ex.en: He looked puzzled when I asked him the question.
ex.zh: 我問他那個問題時，他一臉困惑。

ex.en: The puzzled child stared at the strange machine.
ex.zh: 那個一臉困惑的孩子盯著這台奇怪的機器。

ex.en: We made a soup from fresh pumpkin.
ex.zh: 我們用新鮮的南瓜做了一鍋湯。

ex.en: The children carved a face into a big pumpkin.
ex.zh: 孩子們在一顆大南瓜上刻了一張臉。

ex.en: Pumpkin pie is a popular dessert in autumn.
ex.zh: 南瓜派是秋天很受歡迎的甜點。

published.zh: 出版、發表（過去式、過去分詞）

ex.en: The author published her first novel when she was thirty.
ex.zh: 這位作家在三十歲時出版了她的第一本小說。

ex.en: Their research was published in a well-known journal last year.
ex.zh: 他們的研究去年發表在一份知名期刊上。

ex.en: The published version of the report is shorter than the draft.
ex.zh: 報告的出版版本比草稿短。

ex.en: She has several published articles on healthy eating.
ex.zh: 她有好幾篇關於健康飲食的已發表文章。

ex.en: The puppy ran around the yard chasing a ball.
ex.zh: 小狗在院子裡追著球跑。

ex.en: We adopted a puppy from the animal shelter.
ex.zh: 我們從動物收容所領養了一隻小狗。

ex.en: The purity of the mountain water amazed the hikers.
ex.zh: 山泉水的純淨讓登山客讚嘆。

ex.en: Jewelers test the purity of gold before selling it.
ex.zh: 珠寶商在出售前會檢測黃金的純度。

ex.en: She is purchasing a new laptop for school.
ex.zh: 她正在為上學購買一台新筆電。

ex.en: They are purchasing tickets online for tonight's show.
ex.zh: 他們正在線上購買今晚演出的票。

ex.en: The company's purchasing department compares prices carefully.
ex.zh: 公司的採購部門會仔細比價。

ex.en: Online purchasing has changed how people shop.
ex.zh: 網路購物改變了人們的購物方式。

ex.en: The children laughed at the puppet show.
ex.zh: 孩子們被木偶劇逗得哈哈大笑。

ex.en: The king was only a puppet controlled by his advisers.
ex.zh: 那位國王只是被顧問操控的傀儡。

ex.en: He loves punk and goes to concerts every month.
ex.zh: 他熱愛龐克音樂，每個月都去聽演唱會。

ex.en: She dyed her hair bright green and dressed like a punk.
ex.zh: 她把頭髮染成亮綠色，打扮得像個龐克。

ex.en: The old man shouted at the punk who was kicking his fence.
ex.zh: 老先生對著那個踢他圍牆的小混混大吼。

ex.en: Don't listen to that punk, he's just trying to start trouble.
ex.zh: 別理那個小混混，他只是想惹麻煩。

ex.en: A puff of smoke rose from the chimney.
ex.zh: 一縷煙從煙囪冒出來。

ex.en: He blew out the candles with a single puff.
ex.zh: 他一口氣就吹熄了蠟燭。

ex.en: She was puffing as she climbed the last stairs.
ex.zh: 她爬最後幾階樓梯時氣喘吁吁。

ex.en: The old train puffed slowly up the hill.
ex.zh: 那輛老火車噗噗地慢慢爬上山坡。

ex.en: I like orange juice with lots of pulp.
ex.zh: 我喜歡果肉很多的柳橙汁。

ex.en: Paper is made from wood pulp.
ex.zh: 紙是用木漿製成的。

ex.en: Pulp the tomatoes before adding them to the sauce.
ex.zh: 把番茄打成泥後再加進醬汁裡。

ex.en: The old books were pulped and recycled.
ex.zh: 舊書被打成紙漿再回收。

ex.en: He putted the ball slowly toward the hole.
ex.zh: 他把球緩緩推向洞口。

ex.en: She putted from six feet away and made it.
ex.zh: 她從六英尺外推桿進洞。

ex.en: That was a difficult putt, but he made it.
ex.zh: 那一桿推桿很難，但他推進了。

ex.en: She missed an easy putt on the last hole.
ex.zh: 她在最後一洞漏掉了一個簡單的推桿。

ex.en: The website purports to offer free tickets.
ex.zh: 這個網站號稱提供免費門票。

ex.en: The letter purports to be from the mayor, but it looks fake.
ex.zh: 這封信聲稱出自市長之手，但看起來是假的。

ex.en: He purports to be an expert in the field.
ex.zh: 他自稱是這個領域的專家。

ex.en: I could not understand the purport of his message.
ex.zh: 我無法理解他訊息的要旨。

ex.en: The purport of her speech was clear to everyone.
ex.zh: 她演說的主旨對每個人都很明確。

ex.en: The court ordered punitive damages against the company.
ex.zh: 法院判令該公司支付懲罰性賠償。

ex.en: Many parents believe punitive measures don't teach children much.
ex.zh: 許多父母認為懲罰性的做法無法教會孩子太多。

ex.en: The kids jumped into every puddle on the way home.
ex.zh: 孩子們回家路上每個水坑都要跳進去。

ex.en: After the rain, a big puddle formed in front of the door.
ex.zh: 下雨後，門前積了一大灘水。

ex.en: The punter lost all his money on the horse race.
ex.zh: 那個賭客在賽馬上輸光了所有的錢。

ex.en: Every punter at the track hoped for a lucky win.
ex.zh: 賽馬場上每個賭客都盼著幸運贏錢。

ex.en: A punter guided the boat slowly along the river.
ex.zh: 一位撐篙的船夫帶著小船沿著河緩緩前行。

ex.en: The tourists paid the punter for a short ride.
ex.zh: 遊客付錢給撐篙的船夫，搭了一小段船。

ex.en: Remember to punctuate your sentences correctly.
ex.zh: 記得要為句子正確加上標點。

ex.en: The teacher showed us how to punctuate a long paragraph.
ex.zh: 老師示範了如何為一段長文加標點。

ex.en: His speech was punctuated by loud applause.
ex.zh: 他的演講不時被熱烈掌聲打斷。

ex.en: Her story was punctuated with jokes and laughter.
ex.zh: 她的故事中穿插著笑話與笑聲。

ex.en: Our dog had four pups last month.
ex.zh: 我們的狗上個月生了四隻小狗。

ex.en: The seal pup rested on the rocks next to its mother.
ex.zh: 海豹寶寶在岩石上依偎著牠的媽媽。

ex.en: A political pundit appeared on TV to discuss the news.
ex.zh: 一位政治評論員上電視討論時事。

ex.en: Sports pundits think our team will win the title.
ex.zh: 體育評論員認為我們的隊伍會奪冠。

ex.en: The priest climbed the steps to the pulpit.
ex.zh: 神父走上台階，來到講道壇。

ex.en: The old wooden pulpit was carved with flowers.
ex.zh: 那座老舊的木製講道壇雕著花朵。

ex.en: The school will publicise the event on social media.
ex.zh: 學校會在社群媒體上宣傳這場活動。

ex.en: They hired a writer to publicise the new book.
ex.zh: 他們請了一位作家來為這本新書宣傳。

ex.en: The Puritans left England to build a new life in America.
ex.zh: 清教徒離開英國，到美洲展開新生活。

ex.en: My grandfather was a puritan who never touched alcohol.
ex.zh: 我祖父是個一絲不苟的人，從不碰酒。

ex.en: The baby ate carrot puree for lunch.
ex.zh: 寶寶午餐吃胡蘿蔔泥。

ex.en: The chef served the fish with a pea puree.
ex.zh: 主廚將魚搭配豌豆泥上桌。

ex.en: Puree the tomatoes until the sauce is smooth.
ex.zh: 把番茄打成泥，直到醬汁變得滑順。

ex.en: She pureed the soup with a hand blender.
ex.zh: 她用手持攪拌棒把湯打成濃稠狀。

ex.en: The singer's publicist answered questions from reporters.
ex.zh: 那位歌手的公關人員回答了記者的提問。

ex.en: She works as a publicist for a film studio.
ex.zh: 她在一家電影公司擔任宣傳人員。

ex.en: The company decided to purge old files from its system.
ex.zh: 公司決定清除系統裡的舊檔案。

ex.en: The new leader purged the party of his rivals.
ex.zh: 新領導人把政敵從黨內清洗掉了。

ex.en: The government carried out a purge of corrupt officials.
ex.zh: 政府對貪腐官員進行了整肅。

ex.en: A spring purge of the closet is a good habit.
ex.zh: 春天徹底清理衣櫃是個好習慣。

ex.en: My eyes were puffy after a night of crying.
ex.zh: 哭了一夜後，我的眼睛腫腫的。

ex.en: He woke up with a puffy face.
ex.zh: 他醒來時臉浮腫。

ex.en: She wore a puffy jacket in the snow.
ex.zh: 她在雪中穿著蓬鬆的外套。

ex.en: The puffy clouds floated across the sky.
ex.zh: 蓬鬆的雲朵飄過天空。

ex.en: She walked with a purposeful stride toward the office.
ex.zh: 她邁著堅定的步伐走向辦公室。

ex.en: He leads a purposeful life with clear goals.
ex.zh: 他過著有明確目標的有意義生活。

ex.en: This machine can purify the air in your bedroom.
ex.zh: 這台機器可以淨化你臥室裡的空氣。

ex.en: They boil the water to purify it before drinking.
ex.zh: 他們把水煮沸淨化後才飲用。

ex.en: Workers purify the metal to remove unwanted materials.
ex.zh: 工人們提煉這種金屬以去除雜質。

ex.en: Scientists purify the salt before using it in the experiment.
ex.zh: 科學家在實驗中使用鹽之前會先提純。

ex.en: He is pumping air into the bicycle tire.
ex.zh: 他正在替腳踏車輪胎打氣。

ex.en: The workers are pumping water out of the flooded basement.
ex.zh: 工人們正把淹水地下室裡的水抽出去。

ex.en: My heart was pumping fast after the run.
ex.zh: 跑完步後我的心跳得很快。

ex.en: The heart keeps pumping blood through the body.
ex.zh: 心臟持續把血液輸送到全身。

ex.en: He purposely left early to avoid meeting her.
ex.zh: 他故意提早離開，以避免碰到她。

ex.en: I did not purposely break the cup, it slipped.
ex.zh: 我不是故意打破杯子的，是它滑掉了。

ex.en: The teacher purposely left some questions unanswered.
ex.zh: 老師故意留下一些問題不回答。

ex.en: We rented a punt and floated down the river.
ex.zh: 我們租了一艘平底小船，順著河漂流。

ex.en: Visitors can take a punt ride past the old colleges.
ex.zh: 遊客可以搭平底小船經過古老的學院。

ex.en: The player had to punt the ball on fourth down.
ex.zh: 那位球員在第四次進攻時必須把球高踢出去。

ex.en: They punted along the quiet river on a sunny afternoon.
ex.zh: 在一個晴朗的午後，他們撐著平底小船沿著寧靜的河前進。

ex.en: Most children reach puberty between the ages of ten and fifteen.
ex.zh: 大多數孩子在十到十五歲之間進入青春期。

ex.en: His voice changed when he hit puberty.
ex.zh: 他進入青春期後，聲音就變了。

publicized.zh: 公開宣傳、廣為宣揚（publicize 的過去式與過去分詞）

ex.en: The company publicized its new phone with a big advertising campaign.
ex.zh: 這家公司用大型廣告活動宣傳新手機。

ex.en: The trial was widely publicized in the local news.
ex.zh: 這場審判在地方新聞中被廣泛報導。

ex.en: The title of the book is a clever pun.
ex.zh: 這本書的書名是個巧妙的雙關語。

ex.en: My dad loves making puns at the dinner table.
ex.zh: 我爸爸很愛在餐桌上說雙關語。

ex.en: He puns about everything, which annoys his sister.
ex.zh: 他什麼都能拿來玩雙關語，這讓他姊姊很煩。

ex.en: The comedian punned on the word "bank" for the whole joke.
ex.zh: 喜劇演員整個笑話都在拿「bank」這個字玩雙關。

pulitzer.zh: 普立茲（美國報業人物，普立茲獎以其命名）

ex.en: Joseph Pulitzer was a newspaper publisher in the United States.
ex.zh: 約瑟夫·普立茲是美國的報業發行人。

ex.en: The Pulitzer Prize is named after him.
ex.zh: 普立茲獎就是以他命名的。

ex.en: The pungent smell of garlic filled the kitchen.
ex.zh: 大蒜刺鼻的氣味充滿了廚房。

ex.en: This cheese has a strong, pungent flavor.
ex.zh: 這種起司味道濃烈嗆鼻。

ex.en: Punjab is a region in the north of the Indian subcontinent.
ex.zh: 旁遮普是南亞次大陸北部的一個地區。

ex.en: The name Punjab means the land of five rivers.
ex.zh: 旁遮普這個名字的意思是五河之地。

ex.en: It is puzzling that he did not call us back.
ex.zh: 他沒有回電給我們，真令人費解。

ex.en: The detective found the case very puzzling.
ex.zh: 偵探覺得這個案子非常令人摸不著頭緒。

ex.en: A nail punctured the front tire of my bike.
ex.zh: 一根釘子刺穿了我腳踏車的前輪胎。

ex.en: Be careful not to puncture the plastic bag.
ex.zh: 小心別把塑膠袋戳破。

ex.en: I had a puncture on the way to work.
ex.zh: 我上班途中爆胎了。

ex.en: The nurse covered the small puncture with a bandage.
ex.zh: 護理師用繃帶蓋住那個小小的針孔。

ex.en: She walked purposefully toward the front office.
ex.zh: 她堅定地走向前方的辦公室。

ex.en: He purposefully left the door open for the cat.
ex.zh: 他特意把門開著讓貓進來。

ex.en: The teacher is punishing the whole class for the prank.
ex.zh: 老師為了那場惡作劇處罰全班。

ex.en: Punishing a child too harshly can backfire.
ex.zh: 對孩子處罰過重可能會適得其反。

ex.en: They ran at a punishing pace.
ex.zh: 他們以令人筋疲力盡的速度跑步。

ex.en: The team faced a punishing schedule this month.
ex.zh: 這支球隊這個月的賽程非常吃重。

ex.en: The troops announced a full pullout from the area.
ex.zh: 軍隊宣布全面撤出該地區。

ex.en: The company's pullout from the market surprised investors.
ex.zh: 公司撤出市場令投資人感到意外。

ex.en: The magazine has a pullout map of the city in the middle.
ex.zh: 這本雜誌中間附有一張可抽出的城市地圖。

ex.en: I keep the pullout poster on my bedroom wall.
ex.zh: 我把那張插頁海報貼在臥室牆上。

ex.en: Waves pummeled the small boat all night.
ex.zh: 海浪整晚猛烈拍打那艘小船。

ex.en: The boxer pummeled the bag until he was tired.
ex.zh: 拳擊手不斷猛擊沙袋直到累了為止。

ex.en: He likes to putter around in the garden on Sundays.
ex.zh: 他週日喜歡在花園裡慢悠悠地忙東忙西。

ex.en: My grandfather puttered in the garage all afternoon.
ex.zh: 我祖父整個下午都在車庫裡晃來晃去、東摸西摸。

ex.en: He sank the ball with a single putter stroke.
ex.zh: 他用推桿一擊就把球推進洞。

ex.en: She bought a new putter for her golf game.
ex.zh: 她為了打高爾夫買了一支新的推桿。

ex.en: The old pueblo in New Mexico attracts many visitors.
ex.zh: 新墨西哥州那座古老的普韋布洛村落吸引了許多遊客。

ex.en: The houses of the pueblo are built from clay and stone.
ex.zh: 這個普韋布洛村落的房屋是用黏土和石頭蓋成的。

ex.en: The player shot the puck into the net.
ex.zh: 那名球員把冰球射進了球網。

ex.en: A hockey puck is made of hard rubber.
ex.zh: 冰上曲棍球的球是用硬橡膠做成的。

ex.en: Puck is a playful fairy in a famous play by Shakespeare.
ex.zh: 帕克是莎士比亞一齣著名戲劇中愛惡作劇的小精靈。

ex.en: The student played Puck in the school's summer play.
ex.zh: 那位學生在學校的夏季戲劇中飾演帕克。

purist.zh: 純粹主義者；堅持正統的人

ex.en: As a purist, he only drinks coffee without sugar or milk.
ex.zh: 他是個堅持原味的人，咖啡只喝不加糖不加奶的。

ex.en: The language purist complained about every new slang word.
ex.zh: 那位語言純粹主義者對每個新的俚語都有意見。

ex.en: A pulsar is a spinning star that sends out regular pulses.
ex.zh: 脈衝星是一種會發出規律脈衝、不斷自轉的星體。

ex.en: Astronomers discovered a new pulsar using a radio telescope.
ex.zh: 天文學家用電波望遠鏡發現了一顆新的脈衝星。

ex.en: The putative author of the letter has never been confirmed.
ex.zh: 這封信的所謂作者始終沒有被證實。

ex.en: He is the putative leader of the group, though nobody voted for him.
ex.zh: 他被認為是這個團體的領導者，雖然沒有人投票選他。

ex.en: The restaurant is a purveyor of fine local cheese.
ex.zh: 那間餐廳供應上等的在地起司。

ex.en: He became the main purveyor of fresh fish to the hotel.
ex.zh: 他成了那間飯店鮮魚的主要供應商。

ex.en: The publican poured a pint for each customer.
ex.zh: 酒館老闆為每位客人倒了一品脫啤酒。

ex.en: A friendly publican runs the pub on the corner.
ex.zh: 一位友善的酒館老闆經營轉角的那間酒館。

ex.en: The cat began to purr when I stroked its back.
ex.zh: 我摸貓的背時，牠開始發出呼嚕聲。

ex.en: The engine purred quietly as the car pulled away.
ex.zh: 車子駛離時，引擎輕輕地發出低鳴。

ex.en: I could hear the soft purr of the kitten.
ex.zh: 我聽得到小貓輕輕的呼嚕聲。

ex.en: The purr of the engine put the baby to sleep.
ex.zh: 引擎的低鳴聲讓寶寶睡著了。

ex.en: The workers used a pulley to lift the heavy box.
ex.zh: 工人們用滑輪把沉重的箱子吊起來。

ex.en: A simple pulley makes it easier to raise a flag.
ex.zh: 簡單的滑輪能讓升旗更輕鬆。

ex.en: The thief ran through the market, but his pursuer was close behind.
ex.zh: 小偷跑過市場，但追趕他的人緊跟在後。

ex.en: The fox escaped from its pursuer by jumping into the stream.
ex.zh: 狐狸跳進小溪，甩掉了追趕牠的對象。

ex.en: The puny kitten was smaller than all the others.
ex.zh: 那隻瘦弱的小貓比其他貓都小。

ex.en: Their puny effort did nothing to solve the problem.
ex.zh: 他們那點微不足道的努力，對解決問題毫無幫助。

ex.en: She put on a warm wool pullover before going out.
ex.zh: 出門前，她穿上一件保暖的羊毛套頭衫。

ex.en: This blue pullover was a gift from my aunt.
ex.zh: 這件藍色套頭毛衣是阿姨送我的禮物。

ex.en: The purported author of the letter denied writing it.
ex.zh: 這封信據稱的作者否認寫過它。

ex.en: They investigated the purported cure for the disease.
ex.zh: 他們調查這種號稱能治病的療法。

ex.en: She folded the pushchair and put it in the car trunk.
ex.zh: 她把嬰兒推車折起來，放進後車廂。

ex.en: The baby fell asleep in the pushchair during our walk.
ex.zh: 散步時，寶寶在推車裡睡著了。

ex.en: She looked at the strange map with puzzlement.
ex.zh: 她一臉困惑地看著那張奇怪的地圖。

ex.en: To my puzzlement, the door was already open.
ex.zh: 令我不解的是，門已經開著了。

ex.en: The painting was purportedly made in the 1600s.
ex.zh: 據稱這幅畫是十七世紀完成的。

ex.en: The man purportedly lost his keys on the train.
ex.zh: 據說那名男子的鑰匙是在火車上弄丟的。

ex.en: Safety rules fall within the purview of this committee.
ex.zh: 安全規定屬於這個委員會的職權範圍。

ex.en: That question is outside my purview.
ex.zh: 那個問題不在我的職權範圍內。

ex.en: The baby had pudgy little fingers.
ex.zh: 那個嬰兒有一雙圓滾滾的小手指。

ex.en: He was a pudgy boy with rosy cheeks.
ex.zh: 他是個臉頰紅潤、胖嘟嘟的男孩。

ex.en: The old man was puffing as he climbed the stairs.
ex.zh: 老先生爬樓梯時一直喘著氣。

ex.en: The train came puffing into the station.
ex.zh: 火車噗噗地噴著煙駛進車站。

ex.en: She puckered her lips to blow out the candle.
ex.zh: 她噘起嘴唇吹熄蠟燭。

ex.en: The sour lemon made his face pucker.
ex.zh: 酸檸檬讓他整張臉皺了起來。

ex.en: The salesman was so pushy that I left the shop.
ex.zh: 那個銷售員太強硬地推銷，我就離開了那間店。

ex.en: She is not pushy, but she always gets her point across.
ex.zh: 她並不咄咄逼人，卻總能把意思表達清楚。

ex.en: He filled the hole in the window frame with putty.
ex.zh: 他用油灰填補窗框上的洞。

ex.en: The old putty around the glass had dried and cracked.
ex.zh: 玻璃周圍的舊油灰已經乾裂。

publicised.zh: 宣傳；公開（publicise 的過去式）

ex.en: The festival was widely publicised on social media.
ex.zh: 這場慶典在社群媒體上廣為宣傳。

ex.en: The company publicised its new policy last week.
ex.zh: 公司上週公佈了新的政策。

ex.en: Cheating on the exam is punishable by suspension.
ex.zh: 考試作弊可處以停學。

ex.en: Speeding is a punishable offense in most countries.
ex.zh: 超速在多數國家都是應受處罰的行為。

ex.en: You can see the vein pulsate in his neck.
ex.zh: 你可以看到他脖子上的血管在搏動。

ex.en: The lights pulsate in time with the music.
ex.zh: 燈光隨著音樂的節奏閃動。

ex.en: In pursuance of his duties, he visited every branch office.
ex.zh: 為了履行職責，他拜訪了每一間分公司。

ex.en: The company acted in pursuance of the new safety rules.
ex.zh: 公司依照新的安全規定行事。

ex.en: The machine can pulverize rocks into fine powder.
ex.zh: 這台機器能把石頭磨成細粉。

ex.en: Use a blender to pulverize the nuts before baking.
ex.zh: 烘焙前先用果汁機把堅果打成粉。

ex.en: The pug snored loudly on the sofa.
ex.zh: 那隻巴哥犬在沙發上大聲打呼。

ex.en: A pug has a flat face and a curly tail.
ex.zh: 巴哥犬有扁平的臉和捲曲的尾巴。

ex.en: In some beliefs, souls wait in purgatory before heaven.
ex.zh: 在某些信仰中，靈魂在進入天堂前會先待在煉獄。

ex.en: Waiting for the test results was pure purgatory.
ex.zh: 等待檢驗結果簡直是煎熬。

ex.en: Don't put off your homework until the last minute.
ex.zh: 別把作業拖到最後一刻才寫。

ex.en: They put off the wedding because of the bad weather.
ex.zh: 因為天氣不好，他們把婚禮延期了。

put off.en: to move something to a later time or date

ex.en: The strong smell of the food put me off.
ex.zh: 食物的濃烈氣味讓我倒盡胃口。

ex.en: His arrogant attitude put off many customers.
ex.zh: 他傲慢的態度讓許多客人反感。

put off.en: to make someone not want something or dislike it

ex.en: Loud music can put off students who are trying to study.
ex.zh: 大聲的音樂會讓努力讀書的學生分心。

ex.en: The noise from the street put off the speaker for a moment.
ex.zh: 街上的噪音讓講者一時分了心。

put off.en: to take someone's attention away from what they are doing

ex.en: I can't put up with this noise any longer.
ex.zh: 我再也無法忍受這種噪音了。

ex.en: She puts up with a lot from her difficult boss.
ex.zh: 她對難搞的老闆忍耐了很多。

ex.en: Why do you put up with his rude behavior?
ex.zh: 你為什麼要容忍他的無禮行為？

put up with.en: to accept an unpleasant person or situation without complaining
